info.name: Orwickle API
info.description:
Orwickle backend (Node.js + Express) up to week 8: auth, profiles with evidence-based verification, listings with ownership and project evidence, and the admin verification API (investor and project queues, Under Review, request more evidence / changes, verification history).

Run the numbered folders 00-06 in order with the Collection Runner (they log in with the demo accounts from `npm run seed:demo` and carry the tokens along). Folder 99 holds requests you send by hand.
Set the collection variable `adminPassword` first.

exec: pm.test('server and database are up', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(body.database).to.eql('connected'); });

item.name: 01 Login (demo accounts, no OTP needed)

exec: pm.test('returns an access token and the owner role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('owner'); });
pm.test('returns an access token and the owner role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('owner'); });
pm.test('returns an access token and the investor role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('investor'); });
pm.test('returns an access token and the admin role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('admin'); });

Admin sees it in the review queue

item.description: Creates one draft, publishes, approves, edits and deletes it again, so the database is left as it was (audit entries and decisions stay, by design).

exec: pm.test('verification statuses are counted', () => { const u = pm.response.json().users; ['investorsPending', 'underReview', 'needsEvidence', 'rejected', 'expired', 'suspended'].forEach(k => pm.expect(u[k]).to.be.a('number')); });

request.description: Needs at least two pieces of supporting evidence first (see "Add investor evidence as a link"). Saving sends the profile for verification.

formdata.description: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (max 5 MB)

item.name: Upload a verification document (kind in the URL: owners/buyers cnic_front, cnic_back, university_id_front, university_id_back; investors company_registration, network_affiliation, accelerator_affiliation, investment_portfolio, professional_credential)

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF (max 5 MB)

item.name: Add investor evidence as a link (kind in the URL)

request.description: Replaces the evidence of that kind. Changing evidence of a verified investor sends the profile back to Pending.

item.name: Add listing evidence as a file (ownership_proof or project_evidence)

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF (max 5 MB)

item.name: Set listing cover image (needs {{listingId}} of a draft)
Start an account review (status becomes Under Review)
Review an account: approve / reject / request_more (request more evidence)
Review a listing: approve / reject / request_more (request changes)
Suspend an account (ends all its sessions)
